# Universe3090-stories

A heavy Forge 1.20.1 content mod focused on custom dimensions, transformative gameplay states, and animated lore-driven progression systems.

## About this mod

Universe3090-stories is a substantial Forge 1.20.1 mod that adds a custom gameplay layer with atmospheric dimensions, progression-based power mechanics, and a large ecosystem of new items, machines, mobs, and UI systems.

## Key features

- Custom worlds and dimensions  
Explore dedicated dimensions with unique generation rules and ambience, including custom biomes like `Dark`, `My Place dimension` and . Each adds new exploration patterns and environmental pressure.

![Dark Biome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/795a2221dd3ad6f3ac08dc4e229be10d104268ff_0.webp)
Dark Biome (With night vision)

![My Place Dimension](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b13815f61abcaea4eeaf467c7925b0b5bdbae7a8.png)
My Place Dimension

![White Dimension, His home](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/126d6a270eda14dc6fc25228e32e034f3cf7a49e_0.webp)
White Dimension

- Assimilation system  
A deep debuff mechanic that grows in darkness, increases movement and combat penalties, reduces FOV, and pushes player tension through escalation levels. This system introduces real risk/reward gameplay during prolonged exposure to hostile conditions.

- Custom entities and animation  
New hostile entities with custom behavior and animated visuals, making encounters more dynamic and identifiable.

- Huge content expansion  
Adds many new materials, tools, armor pieces, weapons, structures, custom blocks, and world generation content to support late-game progression and varied builds.

![Alisa Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35b19f9d74627e01302f436a949ab6b208dbc459.png)

- Visual and interface systems  
Dimension-specific UX elements, custom crosshair behavior, overlays, teleport markers, and polished feedback for major effects.

- Optional effect integrations  
Extra visual depth is available through optional integration mods for dynamic lighting and advanced particle presets.

## ⚠️ Requirements

1. Minecraft: Forge 1.20.1  
2. Geckolib is required for animated items/entities
3. Palette Lib [Particle Presets (Palette Lib)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/palette-lib) (extended particle features)
4. Optional: RyoamicLights (enhanced dynamic light effects)

## Who is this for

1. Players who like atmospheric progression and high-impact mechanics
2. Players who enjoy exploration with meaningful biome/dimension identity
3. Players who want combat and status systems with strategic consequences
4. Pack makers looking for a strong lore-meets-mechanics content module
